title: FAKE FUR—Don’t buy! ZERO stars
text: FAKE FUR—Don’t buy! ZERO stars. They sent me fake fur! I’ve been in fashion for years I know the difference. $60 wasted on synthetic garbage. I’m so disappointed! It’s not soft or natural. They put a plastic fake blue pleather backing on it. It’s gross. Total RIP-OFF! I will return it!
